ORIGINAL FAMILY272 CHANNEL HAS AN ENTANGLEMENT-BREAKING CUBE

Status: an exact finite separability certificate and a self-contained analytic
reduction prove Theta^3 is EB for the original dimension-21 channel. No new
PPT-cubed counterexample or unbounded EB-index family is obtained. If the source
square non-EB theorem is accepted, this channel has EB index exactly 3.

1. Fixed source and orientation

Source OpenAI math commit fd4aeeb2ee4fc729c18d98444fed42fd0529eeeb, family272,
Entanglement-with-zero-distillable-secret-key-in-local-dimension-ten-September-27-2026.
The four 6-by-4 integer blocks are copied explicitly in verify_cube_stdlib.py.
The Choi convention is J(F)_(i,a),(j,b)=F(E_ij)_(a,b), reference factor first.
Matrices are complex and all CP/EB statements quantify over complex ancillas.

Let Q_r[out,in]=M_in[r,out], r=0,...,5. Let U: C10 -> C4 tensor C4 and
V: C6 -> C4 tensor C4 be the orthonormal symmetric and exterior embeddings,
with lexicographic pairs (i,j), i<=j and i<j. The diagonal entries of U are 1;
off-diagonal symmetric entries are 1/sqrt(2); exterior entries are +/-1/sqrt(2).
Define S(A)=sum_(p,q) K_pq A K_pq*, K_pq=V*(Q_p tensor Q_q)U.
Let K be the real symmetric Hodge matrix written explicitly in the verifier.
It satisfies K*=K, K^2=I. Put C=Ad_K and B=S* C, where S* is the HS adjoint.
The source input/output transpose invariances make its complementary map
R=C S and its adjoint R*=B, on all complex matrices.

Let E:C6 -> C10 be the first-six coordinate inclusion. The source maps are
Phi1=Ad_E S and Phi2=B Ad_E*. Thus Phi2 Phi1=BS. In this notation products
are functional composition, rightmost map first.

The standalone verifier checks the Kraus superoperator's input and output
transpose invariances using integers. The Kraus expression proves CP; output
transpose invariance proves co-CP. Real invertible prefilters preserve PPT,
so S is PPT. Adjoints and unitary conjugation preserve PPT, so B and both
embedded maps are PPT. No Choi eigenvalue tolerance is used here.

2. Exact reduction of the source channel cube

The source channel lives on H0=C10, H1=C10, Hstar=C. It discards off-diagonal
input blocks, moves H0->H1 through c1 Phi1, H1->H0 through c2 Phi2, and sends
missing trace to the absorbing one-dimensional flag. Write
Ai=Phi_i*(I), ci=1/(1+Tr Ai), Fi=I-ci Ai.
Since Ai>=0 and Ai <= (Tr Ai)I, Fi >= ci I>0. Hence the missing-trace
